metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Meta, Nvidia, Kohl’s

content.text:
LIVE
Updated 7 min ago
Stocks to Watch: Meta, Nvidia, Kohl’s
🔎 Meta Platforms (META): The tech giant reached an $18 billion settlement to end a federal trial over social media’s harm to teenagers. Shares initially jumped but quickly reversed course.
↗️ J.M. Smucker (SJM): The owner of Jif peanut butter and Folgers coffee beat expectations in the first quarter and offered an improved outlook for the net-sales decline it penciled in for fiscal 2027. Shares climbed.
↘️ Kohl's (KSS): The department-store retailer recorded lower profit and sales in the second quarter, though it got a boost from tariff refunds. Shares slumped.
